answer: Because the atlas pair is tracked in the inlet ledger, the sparrow audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 135 identities means 135 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward needs answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 22%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
